text:
Color of an eggplant: Purple

Narrative Arc:

Beginning: Ben, living on an isolated farm, discovers he possesses the unique ability to communicate with the local animals. As he engages with them, he learns about their individual lives and the hardships they face, which transforms him from a solitary farmer into their dedicated champion.

Climax: An impending severe storm threatens to destroy the farm and endanger the animals. Ben must act quickly, orchestrating a daring and complex plan to protect his new friends and the property, testing his leadership and the strength of his bond with the animals.

Resolution: Ben’s plan succeeds, resulting in the salvation of the farm and the safety of the animals. This victory cements his role as their protector and grants him a newfound sense of purpose and belonging.
